reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1jAhwQrNwL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71ziGht7yeL._SY256.jpg This mouse is absolutely awesome! I’m a hardcore raider in World of Warcraft Classic, and it has completely changed my game for the better. The response time is super quick, the battery life is excellent, and the buttons are easy to find and very snappy.
Best Buy had it listed at $160, but I picked it up for $100 less—only difference is no box, and honestly, the box isn’t worth $100. The mouse itself is what matters, and the design is incredible. It’s a total showstopper on my desk setup.
It’s also super lightweight, comes with a charging cable and dongle, and is true plug-and-play. Bonus: it works flawlessly on Mac too!

reviews.title: Probably one of the best wireless ,rgb, lightweight mouse. THE MOUSE IS NOT FOR SMALL HANDS
reviews.comment: it’s a good mouse for the price, i initially bought it to connect to my ps5, works and feels like a charm. simply amazing details in the rgb. The software for the mice is relatively easy to understand and work around, they give you so much to play around with. 4/5 for me personally, simply because of my small hands. This mouse is not intended to be used for small hands like myself. although i am still able to use it and game with no discomfort and i feel like thats primarily because of how light it is. Why its not intended for small hands? well… You arent able to comfortably reach the silver side Sniper button. If your thumb is constantly resting on the primary two side buttons WITH SMALL HANDS, you arent really able to press or reach that button at the same speed as you would with other buttons.
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: Great mouse, but buy it new.
reviews.comment:
The mouse is great and being able to control both the acceleration and deceleration is great.  The problem is that I bought it from "Amazon Renewed".  It didn't come with the high speed fob and the usb cable it had doesn't work.  I expected on other reviews that the battery would run out but this thing cannot keep a charge more than 2 hours even with economy settings on.  I suspect it was returned to "swap" with his old mouse and amazon just threw it in a box.
I could live with the battery issues as I have replaced it but I had to order the fob from SteelSeries (Support was excellent, while I had to buy the fob itself they offered to replace the mouse for the battery issue) I would not recommend you buy things like this from the Renewed store as I doubt even Amazon has the necessary staff and expertise to really test it.
Still, even buying the fob and using one of my spare LiON it was about $20 bucks cheaper.  Take that for what you will.
